doc.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014

chapter: Composing and the art of not playing
title: Discipline 100 cassette query
summary: Rowe plays a YouTube piece named Discipline 100 with Berger's name; Berger says it is not him.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Is this okay when it comes on, the chimes?
Yes absolutely. Does this ring a bell with you?

This could be completely my fault, but there’s a thing on the internet, on YouTube, it has a picture of a cassette tape and it’s called “Discipline 100.” It has your name, and later on in the piece some vibes come in. And I just wondered if this —
Interesting. Maybe I’ll send you the link or something.
His name came up. But it could have been an error on my part.
No I don’t know of it.
